name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-sega-cd-icycal
title: Popful Mail (SEGA CD) - Icycal
description:
The background seen in Icycal and Mt. Rip from the SEGA CD version of Popful Mail. It has a very beautiful aurora borealis in the background, but unfortunately, I was unable to rip the color animation due the fact that there is no working emulator debug that works well with the game.

A good fit for snow / ice themed levels.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
